conventions.commits: Conventional commits with scope (e.g. `feat(core): add Swift language support with tree-sitter-swift handler (#1742)`); each commit carries a `Signed-off-by:` DCO trailer and is GPG signed (the HEAD commit reports a signature status of E in this clone, meaning present but not verifiable here). The issue requires GPG-signed, DCO-signed commits.
conventions.testing: Inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` in each languages/*.rs file, with a local parse_<lang> helper that calls set_language, then queries_compile, element-query, inheritance and defuse tests (java.rs, swift.rs). Registry tests are table-driven in languages/mod.rs and lang.rs. Integration tests live in crates/aptu-coder/tests/ and use common::call_tool_raw plus tempfile::NamedTempFile. Test-only exemptions for unwrap/expect are set in each lib.rs.
conventions.linting: cargo clippy -- -D warnings (CI also uses --locked --profile ci); cargo fmt --check; cargo deny check advisories licenses (7-day package age gate, SKIP_PACKAGE_AGE_CHECK must not be used); REUSE compliance. Workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used and expect_used; unreachable_pub is warn; clippy.toml sets cognitive-complexity-threshold = 30.
conventions.error_handling: Library code returns Option/Vec and avoids panics: get_node_text returns None on out-of-range bytes, child lookups use child_by_field_name/named_child with u32::try_from(i).unwrap_or(u32::MAX), and query compile failures are logged once with tracing::error! and surfaced as ParserError::UnsupportedLanguage or a compile error.

patterns: Registry arm per language in languages/mod.rs get_language_info(): `"java" => Some(LanguageInfo { name: "java", language: tree_sitter_java::LANGUAGE.into(), element_query: java::ELEMENT_QUERY, ... extract_inheritance: Some(java::extract_inheritance), })`.
Query constants are `pub const NAME_QUERY: &str = r"...";` with a doc comment, and CALL_QUERY may be empty (css.rs uses `""`).

Element queries capture the declaration as @function or @class and the name as a dedicated capture (@method_name, @class_name); parser_elements.rs reads func_name, method_name, class_name, type_name explicitly and falls back to child_by_field_name("name").
Defuse captures use prefixes write.*, read.*, writeread.* and parser_elements.rs classifies them by prefix and de-duplicates read captures at write offsets.
Inheritance handlers return Vec<String> with 'extends X' / 'implements X' (java.rs, swift.rs uses 'extends' and 'conforms'); swift.rs guards on node.kind() first and returns Vec::new() otherwise.
Language modules that lack a feature return None in the registry or use a no-op query (html is a None arm; markdown and yaml use None for defuse and inheritance).
Query compile is lazy per language through a OnceLock table built from supported_languages(), so a new name must appear there.
Extension lookup is a case-insensitive linear scan over EXTENSION_MAP, and the schema pattern is generated from the same map (lang.rs test checks every entry).

approaches.name: A. Mirror Java end to end (recommended)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 to the workspace and core Cargo files; create languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class, interface, trait, enum), CALL_QUERY (free, ->, ::), REFERENCE_QUERY (named_type), IMPORT_QUERY (namespace_use_declaration), DEFUSE_QUERY (variable_name writes and reads), and extract_inheritance walking base_clause and class_interface_clause; wire php into lang.rs (EXTENSION_MAP, supported_languages) and mod.rs (pub mod, get_language_info, get_ts_language, registry test row); add inline tests and one integration test; update README counts.
pros: Satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue, including extends/implements and the HTML-template edge case
Same five-query layout as java.rs, so reviewers see a familiar shape
Every node kind and field used is confirmed in node-types.json and verified by parsing
Keeps supported_languages() and the registry in step, which avoids the UnsupportedLanguage trap
cons: Needs the Cargo.lock regeneration and the 7-day age check to pass
Medium amount of query tuning for DEFUSE and CALL to avoid duplicate sites
Binary size delta must be measured with a release build

approaches.name: B. Minimal registration first
approaches.description: Register php with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY and IMPORT_QUERY only; set defuse_query, reference_query and extract_inheritance to None, then add the remaining handlers in a follow-up.
pros: Smallest diff; quickest path to analyze_file returning language: php
Lower risk to the shared registry and the query cache
cons: Fails acceptance criteria for extends/implements and def-use, so a second PR would be needed
Leaves the java.rs-style DEFUSE pattern untested
Two rounds of wiring and binary size measurement

approaches.name: C. Adapt the grammar's own queries/tags.scm
approaches.description: Use the crate's queries/tags.scm (exposed as tree_sitter_php::TAGS_QUERY) as the base for ELEMENT_QUERY and REFERENCE_QUERY, remapping its captures (@name, @definition.*, @reference.call, @reference.implementation) to the @function/@class and *_name capture names the core reads; write CALL, IMPORT and DEFUSE by hand.
pros: Uses the grammar authors' own symbol patterns, which are kept current with the grammar
reference.implementation on class_interface_clause gives a ready-made inheritance hook
cons: Its captures do not match the core's expected names, so every pattern needs remapping
The first 80 lines of tags.scm do not show enum_declaration; enums would need a custom pattern (not checked further)
Upstream query changes can silently alter symbol output between grammar releases

recommendation: Approach A. It is the only option that meets every acceptance criterion in the issue, and it matches the java.rs layout the issue names. Every node kind and field it uses was checked against php/src/node-types.json and parsed successfully with tree-sitter-php 0.25.2: the element query compiled and matched classes, interfaces, traits, enums, functions and methods; the inheritance walk returned the expected extends and implements entries; and the mixed HTML template parsed with has_error = False under LANGUAGE_PHP. Before merging, confirm that supported_languages() includes "php" (or the analyze path returns UnsupportedLanguage), that the crates.io publish date clears the 7-day age gate, and that the #1063 binary size reference in the issue is corrected.

inheritance_walk_citation: Grammar source inspected: tree-sitter-php master at php/grammar.js, which is only `defineGrammar('php')`; the rules live in common/define-grammar.js (fetched via gh api; crate tag v0.25.2, commit c1e13490). Relevant rules, verbatim: class_declaration: seq(optional(field('attributes', $.attribute_list)), repeat($._modifier), keyword('class'), field('name', reserved('classes', $.name)), optional($.base_clause), optional($.class_interface_clause), field('body', $.declaration_list)); base_clause: seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name)); class_interface_clause: seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name)); interface_declaration: seq(..., keyword('interface'), field('name', reserved('classes', $.name)), optional($.base_clause), field('body', $.declaration_list)); enum_declaration: seq(..., keyword('enum'), field('name', ...), optional(seq(':', alias(choice('string','int'), $.primitive_type))), optional($.class_interface_clause), field('body', $.enum_declaration_list)); trait_declaration has no extends/implements clause; _name is a hidden choice of name | qualified_name | relative_name (plus keyword aliases). Walk: (1) class_declaration node; (2) name via child_by_field_name("name") (a field); (3) base_clause and class_interface_clause are NOT fields, so iterate node.children() and match kind == "base_clause" / "class_interface_clause"; (4) for each matched clause iterate named_children() whose kind is name, qualified_name or relative_name; (5) emit format!("extends {text}") for base_clause children and format!("implements {text}") for class_interface_clause children, text taken with get_node_text. Verified by parsing with tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 (Python binding in /tmp venv, outside the clone): `abstract class Animal extends Base implements A, B {...}` gives base_clause[name 'Base'] and class_interface_clause[name 'A', name 'B']; `class Dog extends \App\Animal {}` gives base_clause[qualified_name '\App\Animal'] (leading backslash retained); `interface Shape extends HasArea, Named {}` gives two extends entries from one base_clause; `enum Suit: string implements HasLabel {...}` gives class_interface_clause[name 'HasLabel']; `trait Loggable {...}` and `class Plain {}` give no clauses, so the result is an empty Vec.
